post_title: Multipurpose zigzag sewing machine
post_content:
A zigzag sewing machine is a type of sewing machine that creates a side-to-side stitch, rather than a straight line, to form a zigzag pattern. This stitch is useful for reinforcing seams, preventing fabric fraying, and creating decorative patterns. They are versatile and commonly used in garment construction, upholstery, and various other sewing projects. 
Key Features and Uses:
  • Versatility:
    Zigzag sewing machines can handle a wide range of fabrics, from lightweight materials to heavy-duty ones like canvas and leather. 
  • Seam Reinforcement:
    The zigzag stitch is known for its strength and flexibility, making it ideal for seams on stretchable fabrics and areas prone to stress. 
  • Finishing Edges:
    Zigzag stitches can be used to neaten raw edges of fabric, preventing fraying. 
  • Decorative Stitching:
    The zigzag pattern can be used to add decorative elements to sewing projects. 
  • Different Types:
    There are various types of zigzag machines, including multipurpose models for general sewing and heavy-duty models for specialized applications. 
  • User-Friendly:
    Many zigzag machines are designed for ease of use, making them suitable for beginners. 
  • Adjustable Stitch Settings:
    Most zigzag machines allow you to adjust the stitch width and length, offering flexibility for different projects. 
Specific Applications:
  • Garment Construction:
    Zigzag stitches are commonly used for finishing seams, attaching elastic, and creating decorative details on clothing. 
  • Upholstery:
    They are valuable for sewing durable fabrics used in furniture and other upholstery projects. 
  • Home Décor:
    Zigzag machines are used to create a variety of home décor items, such as curtains, pillows, and tablecloths. 
  • Heavy Fabric Work:
    Heavy-duty zigzag machines are capable of sewing through thick materials like canvas and leather.

post_title: Pedrollo Water Pump 0.5 HP Italy PKM60
post_content:
The Original Pedrollo PKm60 is a robust, reliable and economical pump used principally for water transfer in domestic and small scale water transfer applications. The pump body is made from cast iron with a brass insert set into the front housing for improved starting performance and protection from jamming. The impeller is made from brass.
Pedrollo Pumps can be installed for manual or automatic control using either the unique ‘Presscontrol’ unit or a pressure tank and switch. Also available is the integral ‘Hydrofresh’ version (Pkm60 only) which combines a 24L horizontal diaphragm tank, pressure switch and gauge with pressure settings of 1.4 Bar for pump start and 2.8 Bar for pump stop.
Pedrollo MOTORPumps are close coupled to a TEFC brushless induction motor designed for continuous operation. A thermal relay is provided in the windings to protect against electrical and mechanical overload and the pump can be connected directly to the mains power supply through a 10amp fuse or MCB.
